item.text: The input exposes one point scalar array (`Scalars_`). I’ve configured TTK’s persistence-based simplifier on that array at 0.04 and am now filtering the resulting diagram down to homology orders 0 and 2 for the final display.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p /workspace/.tmp && /opt/conda/bin/pvpython - <<'PY' > /workspace/.tmp/diag_probe.txt 2>&1
from paraview.simple import *
r=XMLImageDataReader(FileName=['/workspace/QMCPACK.vti'])
s=TTKTopologicalSimplificationByPersistence(Input=r)
s.InputArray=['POINTS','Scalars_'];s.PersistenceThreshold=0.04;s.ThresholdIsAbsolute=1
p=TTKPersistenceDiagram(Input=s);p.ScalarField=['POINTS','Scalars_'];p.Dimensions='All Dimensions'; p.EmbedinDomain=0
UpdatePipeline(proxy=p)
print('SOUT',s.GetDataInformation().GetDataSetTypeAsString(),s.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfPoints())
print('POUT',p.GetDataInformation().GetDataSetTypeAsString(),p.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfPoints(),p.GetDataInformation().GetNumberOfCells())
print('pointarrays',[(p.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName(),p.GetPointDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetComponentRange(0)) for i in range(p.GetPointDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
print('cellarrays',[(p.GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetName(),p.GetCellDataInformation().GetArrayInformation(i).GetComponentRange(0)) for i in range(p.GetCellDataInformation().GetNumberOfArrays())])
SaveData('/workspace/persistence_diagram_all.vtu',proxy=p)
SaveData('/workspace/persistence_simplified.vti',proxy=s)
PY
status="'$?; tail -50 /workspace/.tmp/diag_probe.txt; exit $status'
